# 1 Clement Chapter 56 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 56 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_056_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 56

**56:1** Therefore let us also intercede for those who have fallen into any trespass, that meekness and humility may be granted to them — so that they may submit not to us but to the will of God. For in this way there will be for them a fruitful and perfect remembrance with compassion before God and the saints.

**56:2** Let us accept correction, at which no one should take offence, beloved. The admonition which we give to one another is good and exceedingly beneficial, for it unites us to the will of God.

**56:3** For thus the holy word says: "The LORD has disciplined me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

**56:4** For whom the LORD loves he disciplines, and he chastises every son whom he receives."

**56:5** "For the righteous will discipline me in mercy and reprove me; but let not the oil of the sinner anoint my head."

**56:6** And again it says: "Blessed is the man whom the LORD reproves — do not refuse the discipline of the Almighty. For he causes pain and yet restores;

**56:7** he wounds, and his hands bring healing.

**56:8** Six times he will rescue you from affliction, and at the seventh time no evil shall touch you.

**56:9** In famine he will save you from death; and in war he will redeem you from the power of the sword.

**56:10** And from the scourge of the tongue he will hide you, and you shall not fear when evil draws near.

**56:11** You shall laugh at the unrighteous and the lawless, and of wild animals you shall have no fear.

**56:12** For wild animals shall be at peace with you.

**56:13** Then you shall know that your house shall be in peace, and the dwelling of your tent shall not fail.

**56:14** And you shall know that your descendants shall be many, and your children shall be like the grass of the field.

**56:15** And you shall come to the grave like ripe grain that has been gathered in due season, or like a heap of grain from the threshing floor collected at the right time."

**56:16** You see, beloved, how great is the protection given to those who are disciplined by the Master; for as a good father he corrects us that we may receive mercy through his holy correction.

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
